category: D-RELEASE-1.0 §11 classification of every OPEN issue. Columns: issue, category, reason, owner. The gate scripts/check_release_blockers.sh cross-checks this ledger against the GitHub labels; drift is RED. Categories: 1.0-blocks | 1.0-outside | post-1.0 | not-a-bug | tracking/contract.

reason: Tracking umbrella of the KOF 1.0 EXIT GATE (the ratified D-RELEASE-1.0 contract + roadmap §24 queue). It is release-process, not a defect — fits none of the four defect categories; 5th category `tracking/contract` created for it (maintainer 20/09).

Design/contract question (rule 6) that BLOCKS 1.0: the consumption model of a package published by `kof deploy --publish`. Re-labeled `1.0-blocks` (triage lane .22, 20/09) after measuring three independent defects bundled here — `kof run --classpath` is a silent no-op (R6), `SEM015` false positive on an external-class constructor, and `build` reporting an error while emitting a valid artifact. Publish/pull/SHA256/latest are green; the KOF-side `import` of the installed jar is an honest PKG006. Blocks until the maintainer decides the model and the bundled defects close. Enters the 0.5.0 gate as a blocker (maintainer 20/09).

Defect (i) split out of #566 (triage lane .22, 20/09): `kof run --classpath` is a silent no-op — the classpath is accepted but not applied, so the program hits `PKG006` at the gate and `NoClassDefFoundError` at runtime (R6: a real input must not be silently dropped). Blocks the package-consumption contract.

Defect (ii) split out of #566 (triage lane .22, 20/09): `SEM015` false positive on the constructor of an external class supplied via `--classpath` — `Greeter()` does not resolve even though emit/lowering work and the program runs. A false diagnostic blocks valid Kof code.

Defect (iii) split out of #566 (triage lane .22, 20/09): `kof build` reports an error but still EMITS a valid artifact — the exit code does not reflect the real output, so a script checking `$?` is misled (pipeline inconsistency, R6).
